text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping with Sirius Symboli.
We're scheduled to train right after this, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There she is!
Heyyy! Sirius~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio and a little girl were standing by the front gate.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She says she's a huge fan of yours, Sirius!
She's been waiting all this time to give you her fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... this! Please take it!
I've always looked up to you..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though the letter was handed over with trembling hands—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hey puppy, take this.
I'm going on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, Sirius?!
...And she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with that?!
That's way too cold~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That attitude... I felt there had to be a reason for it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not letting it end like this!
Let's go after them!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Admiration, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're the one she looks up to,
so please accept her fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Admiration, huh? Entrusting your feelings and ideals to someone else is just pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! It's not silly!
It's because I looked up to the President
that I was able to run all this way!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whatever feelings you've got are your own damn business.
They ain't got nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, training takes priority.
It is as simple as that."

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...! ...U-Um, excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I really like Sirius-san.
She sparkles just like a little star.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what happens to you, Sirius-san,
I'll always support you. I've made up my mind, so—"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius-san... I'm going to
keep chasing after you on my own!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
So—I'm just going to push this on you!
This letter, too!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!! Yeah, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I don't run for other people.
I don't give a damn about your selfish ideals.
However...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm Sirius, the brightest star—what you make of my light is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what the heck~!
So I was just a stepping stone all along, geez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still... as frustrating as it is, that's so like Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging mutual understanding, resolve, and feelings.
I witnessed the strong bond between Sirius Symboli and her fans.
